subject: Request: Partner promo credits for CloudBridge pilot
messages:
From: Dominic Liu <dominic@cloudbridge.partners>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.partners, vanessa@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Partner pilot — promo credit request for joint evaluation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at CloudBridge is excited to run a short pilot for our mutual FSI customer. To make the POC low-friction we ask Redwood to allocate partner promotional credits that will be consumed by the pilot environment.

Summary:
- Customer: Harbor Bank (FSI pilot)
- Pilot scope: 4-week evaluation, ~50k tokens/day estimate
- Requested promo allocation: $25,000 equivalent (Redwood hosted credits)
- Deliverables: pilot SOW, joint case study option

Attached: CBP-Pilot-SOW-v1.pdf (SOW draft), CBP-Promo-Request.xlsx (budget worksheet).

What we need from Redwood: confirmation of promotional credit allocation and routing instructions (which account/bucket to charge), expected expiry, and whether a simple MSA amendment or PO is required.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Dominic Liu
Head of Alliances, CloudBridge Partners
+1 (415) 555-0128

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Cc: Dominic Liu <dominic@cloudbridge.partners>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner pilot — promo credit request for joint evaluation

Vanessa / Ben — looping you both in. Dominic sent the SOW and a worksheet asking for $25k in partner promo credits to cover a 4-week POC for Harbor Bank. Key asks below and next steps I propose: 

What we need to confirm: 
- Whether we can approve $25k from the Partner Promo pool for Q3 (Customer is new and strategic).
- Routing: which internal accounting code/bucket to use (partner promo FY26 Q3?) and whether we need a PO or signed MSA first.
- Expiry: CloudBridge wants credits valid for 90 days from allocation.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Ben — can you confirm if billing can reserve $25k from partner promo and which code to use? I can provide the HubSpot deal id and SOW.
2) Vanessa — do you need any additional partner coverage approvals or partner budget sign-off? 
3) If billing signs off, we'll send them a DocuSign MSA amendment and route allocation form.

Cc'ing Dominic so CloudBridge sees the timeline. I can target confirmation by end of week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Dominic Liu <dominic@cloudbridge.partners>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Partner pilot — promo credit request for joint evaluation

Ben / Markus — forwarding Dominic's request for the Harbor Bank POC. This looks like a standard partner-sourced pilot; timeline tight (pilot starts first week of October). 

Notes for approval team: 
- Partner: CloudBridge Partners (SI)
- Requested amount: $25k Redwood hosted credits
- Purpose: reduce friction for a co-sell pilot and accelerate adoption
- Risk: very low; public sector data handling not involved (customer is a regulated bank but pilot is demo-only with synthetic data)

If billing can route from the Partner Promo bucket and legal confirms MSA amendment template works, we can approve. Ben — please advise if we should cap the allocation to a 60-day expiry instead of 90. 

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>, Dominic Liu <dominic@cloudbridge.partners>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partner pilot — promo credit request for joint evaluation

Thanks for the context. Billing can reserve $25,000 from the Partner Promo FY26 Q3 allocation, charge code PP-FY26Q3, and issue a promo credit memo to CloudBridge's partner account. 

Couple of operational items before we finalize:
- We need a signed amendment/PO on file referencing the HubSpot deal id (DEAL-5482).
- Please fill and return the attached promo-allocation-form.csv so finance can log the transaction (fields: partner_name, amount_usd, deal_id, start_date, expiry_date).
- Default expiry for partner promos is 60 days unless Partnerships approves 90. Let's default to 60 to keep burn rates predictable.

Attached: promo-allocation-form.csv (allocation template).

Once we have the signed file and the completed allocation form, I'll schedule the credit issuance.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Dominic Liu <dominic@cloudbridge.partners>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner pilot — promo credit request for joint evaluation

Dominic — quick update and next steps.

1) Billing has approved reserving $25,000 from Partner Promo FY26 Q3 under charge code PP-FY26Q3. Finance needs the completed promo-allocation-form.csv and a signed MSA amendment/PO referencing DEAL-5482.
2) Default expiry will be 60 days from allocation; if you need 90, let us know and Vanessa will sign off.
3) I've created a DocuSign agreement (link below) with the minimal amendment and HubSpot deal linked; please ask your procurement to sign that and return the PO.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.example.com/rooms/CBP-Pilot-Agreement
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/38291/DEAL-5482

Next steps for CloudBridge:
- Sign the DocuSign amendment (estimated 24–48 hours).
- Complete and return promo-allocation-form.csv.

Once those are in, Ben will post the credit and we can kick off the pilot. Looking forward to moving this forward.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
+1 (650) 555-0199
